body:
# Fluorine — molecular gas supplement and preserved table inventory, 2026-10-07

Stage: IMPLEMENTED. Actual evidence is in the [batch receipt](../../data/quality/thermal-fluorine-batch-2026-10-07.json). The broader scientific and illustration programme remains PARTIAL.

## Identity, provenance and applicability

The [unchanged master](../../records/0009-Fluorine-F/data/structured/0009-Fluorine-F.yaml) owns MAT:0009:MOL:F2 at /ordinary_molecular_state. Atomic Fluorine at /atomic_state and fluoride at /fluoride remain separate. The atomic object lacks an explicit charge; no charge is inserted or inferred to admit it to the gas adapter. The [official NIST SI publisher table](https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?ID=C7782414&Units=SI&Mask=1&Type=JANAFG&Table=on) supplies one molecular F2 GAS fit over **298–6000 K**, on **mol F2** basis. Counting two atoms per molecule is not a conversion of molecular functions to atomic functions.

New SRC-000517 links same_work_as SRC-000160/SRC-F-004 in the [source registry](../../data/registries/sources.yaml); SRC-000159/SRC-F-003 remains distinct atomic work. [Main response](../../data/catalog/sources/nist-thermochemistry-0009-2026-10-07.html.txt) and [publisher response](../../data/catalog/sources/nist-thermochemistry-0009-2026-10-07-table.html.txt) retain exact bytes/hashes and actual 7 October retrieval metadata. Chase1998 and the reported June1982 review are distinct dates. Reserved rights remain explicit; redistribution acceptance is pending.

## Calculations and validation limits

Independent source review checks eight printed coefficients, 59 publisher rows,177 Cp/S/H values and59 additional Gibbs quantities. Independent and shared-library calculations compare101 samples/303 quantities with range and context gates. The publisher first temperature is printed298K, while enthalpy references298.15K; both and the nonzero residual are retained. Applied pressure, fit uncertainty/covariance, isotopic fractions and spin populations remain UNKNOWN or UNSPECIFIED. Separate entropy data, publisher rounding and software residuals do not become coefficient uncertainty. No atomic, ion, compound, condensed-phase, equilibrium mixture or biomedical property is inferred. These are published evaluations and calculated samples; no independent calorimetry or experimental replication was performed.

## Preserved owners and generated representations

The [inventory](../../records/0009-Fluorine-F/data/structured/0009-Fluorine-F-Table-Manifest.yaml) links ten unchanged authored tables whose scientific-content review remains pending. New table011/graph013 follow twelve original [graph reservations](../../records/0009-Fluorine-F/data/structured/0009-Fluorine-F-Graph-Manifest.yaml), with old parent/manifest prefixes preserved. The [reader](../../records/0009-Fluorine-F/0009-Fluorine-F-Thermochemistry.md), [evaluation](../../records/0009-Fluorine-F/data/structured/0009-Fluorine-F-NIST-Thermochemistry.yaml), [table](../../records/0009-Fluorine-F/tables/0009-Fluorine-F-TABLE-011-Thermodynamic-Functions.md), [CSV](../../records/0009-Fluorine-F/tables/0009-Fluorine-F-TABLE-011-Thermodynamic-Functions.csv) and [SVG](../../records/0009-Fluorine-F/graphs/0009-Fluorine-F-GRAPH-013-Heat-Capacity.svg) share the same canonical owner, source, basis and limits. Existing extraction, context, plotting and publication tools are reused; no scientific schema change is needed.

Browser verification found that selecting another record removed and recreated the chart gallery while its reader chapter loaded, causing the entire catalogue to be fetched and parsed again. The [reader lifecycle correction](../../studio/src/App.tsx) keeps the gallery mounted in chart mode during chapter loading. Request-count and material/Fluorine context checks retain the original test timeouts. Failed browser runs and response diagnostics are preserved separately from the final accepted run; no scientific values are changed by this correction.

Preservation covers5,217 prior records,43 thermal owners/receipts,71 gaps,129 artifacts and408 source nodes, including the unchanged master and authored tables. SRM126c owner/certificate/source/artifacts/typed projection stay intact; only its global registry-input hash refreshes. Two private preparation failures were corrected before any canonical mutation; original evidence remains retained. Source/software arithmetic and actual native-image inspection passed. Final integration evidence is entered only after terminal closure.

Coverage is44 thermal owners/147 fits/14,847 calculated rows/71 gaps/272 supplemental charts. Foundation0000, Hydrogen0001 and all119 canonical identities remain intact. All143 master tasks,4,248 domain reviews and2,587 standalone panels remain pending. This chart earns zero standalone A/B credit. Continue through the [same selector](../../data/research/mat-update-review.json), [TODO](../../data/quality/MAT-TODO.json), [resume](../../MAT-ADVANCED-RESUME.md) and [handoff](../../MAT_CODEX_CONTINUATION_HANDOFF.md).

## Next executable task

Review Neon 0010 from .mat-local/thermal-fluorine-2026-10-07/neon-next-preflight.json and its source-review/neon-next-preflight companion prose/captures. First resolve the explicit neutral-atom owner binding: the BASELINE master has nested /identity and no atomic child; existing Neutral-Atom.yaml /entity defines MAT:0010:ATOM:Ne with charge_in_elementary_charge_units 0 and definition-only scope, but the current curated adapter rejects both routes. Preserve both owners and permanent identity; review a compatible adapter/owner contract before accession, without inventing /atomic_states/0 or Ne2. Then independently review the exact Oct7 neutral Ne GAS source: one298–6000K column, eight printed coefficients including tiny exponents,59 publisher rows, Chase1998/March1982, raw298K first row vs298.15K reference and residual. Preserve nine table and eight graph reservations; candidate table010/graph009 require fresh collision checks. Existing optical/ASD/NMR/BIPM source works are distinct; no WebBook work or source ID is reserved. Recompute registered/alias/unresolved collisions only after proof. Keep UNKNOWN pressure/fit uncertainty/covariance and unspecified isotopic scope; monatomic spin-isomer scope remains NOT-APPLICABLE-TO-MONATOMIC-SPECIES. Reuse bounded extraction/sync/plot, preservation, material, tests, publication, browser and final-copy gates after the owner binding passes. Continue0011–0012 individually and remaining domains/image panels afterwards. MAT-PROGRAMME-DATA-FIRST remains PARTIAL.

sources.scope_note: Dated SI response for the existing Fluorine/F2 WebBook work SRC-000160. Preserve its original node and aliases. SRC-000159 is distinct atomic Fluorine work; this retrieval is not independent evidence or a condensed-phase source.
sources.scope: The retained species is molecular F2 GAS, CAS7782-41-4, InChI=1S/F2/c1-2. One mole of F2 molecules contains two moles of fluorine atoms; this species-count relation does not convert thermodynamic F2 functions to atomic F. Bind MAT:0009:MOL:F2 at /ordinary_molecular_state with mol F2 basis. Atomic /atomic_state lacks explicit charge=0 and /fluoride is a distinct ion. No atomic F, fluoride F-, HF, compound or equilibrium dissociation/ionisation mixture follows. The molecular closed-shell ground state and authored monoisotopic natural composition do not supply fit-resolved isotope or spin scope. One GAS Shomate column covers298–6000 K. Preserve all59 publisher rows, including raw298 K first row and its negative-zero rounded enthalpy; distinguish this printed temperature from the298.15 K published enthalpy reference. Retain the calculated reference residual; do not force zero. This one-column source has no duplicated inter-fit endpoints. No below298K/above6000K extrapolation, liquid/solid/cryogenic fluorine, fluid EOS, phase transitions, latent heat or pressure-dependent function is inferred. Preserve Chase1998, reported June1982 data review, actual2026-10-07 retrieval timestamps and private2026-10-07 software review as distinct provenance. No January2009 parameter-fit comment is printed. Shomate has no pressure variable: applied sample pressure is UNKNOWN; the separate source one-bar entropy datum does not specify arbitrary-pressure conditions or coefficient uncertainty. Coefficient uncertainty/covariance remain UNKNOWN; printed rounding and software residuals are not physical uncertainty. Independent parser and Python/JavaScript checks compare the same publisher work, not independent measurements, calorimetry, experimental replication or medical F18/PET efficacy. A dated snapshot should link same_work_as SRC-000160/SRC-F-004 while preserving its supports/aliases. SRC-000159/SRC-F-003 is distinct atomic Fluorine work.
sources.reference: Chase, M.W., Jr. (1998), NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, Fourth Edition. June 1982 data review and October 2026 retrieval are distinct provenance.
